description:
# Feed section lifecycle fix 1.49.0-niconico.9

Backports the exact official Morphe fix [6d4315757768d792614915d0867079437505fab9](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/commit/6d4315757768d792614915d0867079437505fab9), which was missing from this fork's frozen PR snapshot.

Released list sections are removed from the filter registry, preventing an old section from mutating an item list shared with its replacement without updating the replacement's row layout. Grid rows are rebuilt when deletion leaves a nonempty section that is no longer a grid.

The unsuccessful .7/.8 template and measured-width overrides are removed. Existing optional patch selection remains compatible, but it no longer forces widths. The actual lifecycle fix is automatically part of normal Litho filtering. Keep **Feed layout diagnostics** enabled for comparison, and keep all other selections the same as the previous test.

Local validation: tests and Android bundle build; patch/rebuild checks on original YouTube 21.20.405 and 21.23.492; generated release/unregister and row-rebuild calls inspected in the resulting DEX. Phone symptom verification remains required.
